brief:
Jerusalem's electricity company announced it will cut power Monday, October 26, 2026, from 8:30 a.m. to 1:30 p.m., according to Maan Wire. The outage will affect parts of the Kafr Aqab area, including the Zughair neighborhood and al-Yousef 2 housing units and adjacent areas.

The company said the blackout was necessary, though it did not specify the reason for the planned interruption.

title: Jerusalem electricity company cuts power Monday in multiple neighborhoods
